source_scope: Round 85 reviewed full LanaGarden text for QQ-printed Chapters 1262–1271, aligning by exact title with QQ/ReadNovel/Xiaoxiang/Rongshuxia/Traditional Chinese catalog listings. Nine ledger records are appended: two fallen-angel drops taken by Botier, six Balthazar gift receipts, and a previously acquired magic spear transfer to Zola. Event-only progression and combat details are recorded without treating mention/use as a new receipt; no LL01 T0 inventory or event guarantee is changed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 心灵之匕，机械师神技！
outcomes: Three SS chest results: Fire God Greatsword to Nika, Mind Dagger bound to Sarah, X-Starry Firmament book held for Tong Chuchu.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 半神器套装，神之终结者！
outcomes: Five relics: Thunder Claw ×1, Ice Beast Heart ×2, Radiant Feather ×1, Wind Spirit Core ×1. Four relics and four held Legendary Hearts evolve four pets; Wind Spirit Core remains.
Netherlord · God’s Terminator level-200 six-piece semi-artifact set detailed; only chest armor/set effects are profiled here.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 回归！冲击神灵境界！
outcomes: Isabel, Nika and Allen each receive 600 Ice Dragon Crystals (30,000 Divine Power) and begin trials. Cao spends 60,000 Divine Power from a mixed source; split unknown.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 淬炼神性，登神前的考验！
outcomes: The three candidates reach 100% purity and begin trials; Light, Sacred Flame and Wind Godheads are incorporated/consumed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 大动乱，神灵混战！
outcomes: Awakened gods contest territory and worshippers; no protagonist-side loot confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 双极神主，成神试炼！
outcomes: Cao begins special trial; failure penalties and 36,500:1 trial time ratio stated.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 你真的了解寒冰…了解自己吗？
outcomes: Crystal Core quest item awarded; Crystal Element Mastery reaches god tier. Mirrored Ice trial begins.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 生死磨砺，最终阶段试炼开启！
outcomes: Mirror defeated; Ice Element Mastery reaches god tier; final ten-year balance trial begins.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 出关！混乱升级！
outcomes: Seven trial years pass; Cao develops coexistence between crystal/chaotic and ice forces. Divine occupation intensifies; no item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 四神耀世！肃清动乱！
outcomes: Cao Xing, Isabel, Nika and Allen ascend to divine status; territorial blessing underway; ten teams tasked to suppress gods. Two hostile lower gods captured, with no death/drop confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 号令诸神，违逆者杀无赦！
outcomes: Cao Xing’s roster is stated as three upper-god combatants and four more gods at peak midgod combat strength; the visible preview truncates before the full list.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 曹星的实力，碾压神灵！
outcomes: Cao’s cold force freezes the ancient vine god’s branches; no item receipt is visible in the accessible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 肃清开始，神陨如雨！
outcomes: The Flame Queen legion’s survivors witness Angelina being coerced; the visible preview also confirms several territory members were killed by a god’s divine威.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 镇杀！最后的混乱源头！
outcomes: Wind God Allen forms a consuming storm eye over the three-headed giant; no item receipt is visible in the accessible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 曹星VS毁灭之神，双规则现世！
outcomes: Valkyrie is struck away by the Destruction God as the gods react; chapter title confirms the dual-rule confrontation.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 斩杀毁灭之神，单挑无敌！
outcomes: Cao reveals that he can fuse two upper-god divinities; title confirms the Destruction God’s death, but drops are not confirmed in the preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 诸神臣服，乱世终结！
outcomes: Destruction God’s death is confirmed by blood-rain and the broken Destruction rule; title confirms the gods submit.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 清点战后收获，三大下位神技。
outcomes: Nika fuses the Holy Flame Godhead and transforms into Holy Flame Goddess; her advancement grants the visible stats/mastery/territory effects recorded under SX-1382. Three lower-god techniques are identified as self-created; their review begins next chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 突破神灵奖励，超凡入圣！
outcomes: Nika’s named single-target divine skill and Isabel’s unnamed immortal-phoenix summon skill are partially described; third skill name/effect and exact coefficients are unavailable in the visible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 组合神技——冰临天下！
outcomes: A self-select divine-technique chest offers 1 of 12 lower-god techniques across six classes. Cao selects Frost Mage, revealing two books; the preview ends before a final book choice.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 五枚神格，审讯古神。
outcomes: The title establishes the five-Godhead haul; the accessible official opening is about arena rankings, not the item receipt. Later Ch1207 body confirms five new Godheads in Cao Xing’s backpack; individual names/ranks remain unknown.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 再收三神，特殊的增益技能。
outcomes: The chapter title confirms three more gods join and a special buff skill; visible text opens on interrogation of the captured Vine Ancient God. Exact names and buff mechanics are not available in the preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 解封，诺恩圣女苏醒！
outcomes: Zola/Norn Saint, previously believed dead, is stated to have been frozen in the deep-sea ice abyss and later recovered into Cao Xing’s territory; she is now to awaken.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 收服诺恩圣女，领地第一尊上位神！
outcomes: Zola’s divine body and Godhead are described as severely damaged, with cracks involving rule power; Cao Xing promises repair may be possible. No repair item or completed restoration is visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 卓拉真神？重返巅峰的方法！
outcomes: The Pale Sacred Tree’s source-tracing ability is described as available once; the chapter discusses restoring Zola but no specific item receipt is visible in the excerpt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 第五波全体赐福，数十万自爆大军！
outcomes: Cao Xing has five new Godheads in his backpack; three have suitable candidate fusions. A new god needs at least 30,000 Divine Power. One Ice Dragon Crystal restores 50 Divine Power (= five fragments); the similar effect of Wood Crystal is posed as a hypothesis only.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 偿还恩情，远征南大陆！
outcomes: Cao Xing orders nearly 100,000 troops through the cross-region teleportation array and leads an expedition to the South Continent.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 天降女神，让圣焰净化一切！
outcomes: The force arrives at a vast ominous forest with a strong ancient evil presence; no specific loot is visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 雷神祸乱，曹星的猎物！
outcomes: Thunder God’s attack breaks the elves’ barrier, destroys many trees and kills/injures many elves; no reward item is confirmed in the visible excerpt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 风华绝代，南大陆第一女王。
outcomes: The South Continent storyline continues during the thunder crisis; no protagonist-side item receipt is visible in the accessible opening.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 单杀雷神，神格到手！
outcomes: Cao Xing kills Thor; the chapter title confirms one Thunder Godhead obtained. No other exact drops or rank identified.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 雷神法典，为圣女补魔。
outcomes: Thunder God Codex is named and used to replenish a Saint; item acquisition and replenishment amount not established in visible excerpt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 铁匠突破，半神级锻造师
outcomes: A blacksmith reaches demigod forging level; no item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 集齐法典残卷，两处战场的惊人收益
outcomes: Five Legendary Proficiency Emblems confirmed as loot; can promote Francisca to demigod alchemist.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 百万魔法种子，合成神格的途径
outcomes: 1.62 million Random Magic Seed Bags; each yields 1–10 seeds, green through legendary, very small chance of demigod seed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 神级秘药配方
outcomes: God-level potion formula story; handover to Francisca is described in Ch1218 excerpt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 深夜拜访，女王的请求
outcomes: Cao Xing transfers an unnamed God-level potion formula to Francisca and promises to gather 100 ingredient shares; ingredients are not yet received.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 伯捷之父，血脉融合
outcomes: Bojie’s four bloodlines combine; no item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 混沌之神降临，两个月
outcomes: Chaos gods appear and discuss looming threat; no protagonist-side item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 第三阶段扩建完工，兵强马壮
outcomes: Wood Crystal can drop from Legendary Resurrected Army; periodic 25-day harvest is worth 30,000 Divine Power; two-month amount about 80,000, no exact crystal count or per-crystal conversion. 9,000 Divine Power Fragments consumed to ascend Andrew, Francisca and Zevelin; about 10,000 Divine Power remains. Andrew’s named skill 狂野之形·原始解放 is visible, effect truncated.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 星火城新政策，激动的平民们！
outcomes: Starfire City housing/work policy presented as major welfare; no item reward in visible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 构建神国，荆棘圣女的体质。
outcomes: Divine kingdom construction begins; Revelation Sacred Stele suppresses space over 1,000 km radius, but Cao Xing can still break the space.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 神国初成，蜕变！
outcomes: Thorn Saint’s constitution can reduce divine-kingdom construction time to one seventh/about one month; construction risks serious injury or death.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 第一个子嗣诞生，天地宠儿。
outcomes: First child born; realm-area-scaled bonuses described, up to 200% attributes and 100% divine damage.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 精灵女王与幽兰女王的礼物。
outcomes: Elf Queen’s Life’s Tears gift is accepted for Xuewei; lower-level use yields better effect, exact function/grade hidden.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 三个女王一台戏
outcomes: Banquet/relationship scene; no item receipt visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 兑换巨龙卵，满月庆典开始。
outcomes: Dragon-egg exchange named in title; visible preview does not show quantity, type, price, or completed receipt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 故人，湖中女神的礼物。
outcomes: Lake Goddess gift event named; object and handover are not visible in opening preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 不速之客，盗火者的闯入。
outcomes: Fire Thief arrives at the celebration; no item receipt visible in preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 清洗者的‘大礼’，终末之息。
outcomes: Cao Xing probes Fire Thief about the Cleaners; no item handover visible in preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 新·湖女之剑与神国扩张
outcomes: The Lake Goddess provides a new sword for Assam; the text states at least +20% battle strength.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 完整的冰雪法典，绑定神器法袍
outcomes: Previously held Ice and Snow Codex completes repair into a complete mid-tier artifact; no new acquisition is claimed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 神器的隐藏效果，冰龙王族战躯！
outcomes: Snow Burial Star Robe binding adds +400 luck and unlocks large-scale shield state; the shield copies 100% wearer HP/armor/damage reduction and drops below 30% HP.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 第一赛季结束，清点奖励。
outcomes: 14,600 Random Ancient Coin Bags opened; coin outputs and mixed chest results recorded with uncertain chest-tier attribution.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 赛事主办权，神级斗兽场。
outcomes: First-season prizes include arena model, 70,000 Dragon Coins and three self-select chests plus Divine Fire and Ancient Redcloud Chest; hosting rights awarded.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 幽影套装集齐，霜之哀伤
outcomes: Three self-select chests yield Shadow Wings, Water Essence and Frostmourne; 70,000 Dragon Coins exchanged into 7,000 bags; repeat War Saint’s Broken Blade receipt for Talia.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 自选半神技，泰坦能源之心。
outcomes: Titan Energy Heart named in chapter title; the next chapter’s preview sees a metallic energy sphere and Tong Chuchu’s interest; no transfer asserted.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 对抗清理者的配方，黄金瞳！
outcomes: Golden Eye and anti-Cleaner formula appear in the chapter title; accessible preview does not expose recipe details.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 兽神之心，冰冰进化
outcomes: Opening identifies Beast God Heart as a bloodline treasure that can unlock ultimate evolution; full mechanics/acquisition not visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 必杀目标，融入规则。
outcomes: Accessible opening discusses Cleaner targeting and Godhead/rule integration; no new item reward confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 必杀目标，融入规则。
outcomes: Accessible opening discusses the Cleaner kill target and remaining Godhead-rule integration; no item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 纪元之敌，降临倒计时。
outcomes: TTKS excerpt matched by title shows four named fighters reaching Legendary rank and four prior Legendary members reaching Demigod rank, each gaining abilities/skills. These are progression outcomes, not item receipts.
Excerpt says Cao Xing still has remaining rewards to process and is collecting materials for an anti-End-Breath potion; no names, quantities, or completed recipe are visible in the captured portion.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 生命古树上的可采集资源。
outcomes: Official QQ preview identifies the Life Ancient Tree as a harvestable-resource site and describes its growth; named outputs and quantities are not visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 震撼的上古巨龙，寂灭魔龙血脉！
outcomes: TTKS excerpt matched by title records Ancient Beast Arena rules: standardized level-100 Hero template, limited equipment effects, no consumables, pre-match environment preview, single-elimination to 1024 then best-of-three to 128 and challenge finals, five-player teams with up to two substitutes, two ability/effect bans per side, 10-minute solo/20-minute team limits with timeout scoring, and one gatekeeper revival attempt requiring three minutes survived.
The same excerpt depicts Bingbing’s destructive transformation eclipsing the sun and ancient dragons discussing the awakened Annihilation Primordial Dragon bloodline. No loot drop is established.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 太古寂灭魔龙，强大的冰冰！
outcomes: Official title confirms Bingbing’s Annihilation Primordial Dragon transformation; detailed stats and any item receipt are not visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 一体两面，光暗女神的突破方法。
outcomes: Official title identifies a breakthrough method for the Goddess of Light and Darkness; its materials, costs, and outcome remain unverified.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 哭泣的黑暗魔女。
outcomes: Official title identifies the Dark Witch; no item or reward outcome is established.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 审判之神，战争位面——出发！
outcomes: Official title marks departure for the War Plane and Judgment God. An official preview describes Frostmark Paladin’s advancement to Judgment God; no item acquisition is asserted.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 杀戮乐园，疯狂的战争信徒。
outcomes: Official title identifies the Killing Paradise and war believers. The available opening concerns War Plane entry; it does not show a new teleport-stone acquisition.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 进入旭日王庭的条件。
outcomes: Official title identifies entry conditions for the Sun Court; conditions and any required items are not visible.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 沉眠之渊的隐藏生物！
outcomes: Official title identifies a hidden creature in the Sleeping Abyss; identity, drops, and rewards remain unverified.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 十二翼堕天使，寄生丛林之变！
outcomes: A twelve-winged fallen angel guards the Sleeping Abyss and promises a final gift if defeated; no defeat or drop occurs in this chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 传承最终开启！
outcomes: The War Blade fragment campaign records a 5,487,600 inventory snapshot, a later +192 pickup, and a system assertion that 10,000,000 fragments are complete; synthesis reveals the Sunrise King’s Court/War God temple. Visible quantities leave an unresolved 4,512,208 gap.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 三大神将，最锋利的矛与最坚固的盾！
outcomes: Clearing War God trial round three explicitly awards Olli Hall (Mid God Artifact heavy armor, level 260), Flawless Divine Fire ×3, and Divine Power fragments ×1,000. A further final trial is opened; Olli Hall is discussed as suitable for Bron but not yet equipped.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 第三神将，Edith试炼！
outcomes: Edith begins the star-fragment resonance trial. No new item receipt is shown.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 月影星劫，最强刺客传承！
outcomes: Sarah challenges Edith for the complete assassin inheritance; the fight continues, with no completed award in this chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 执掌星月权柄，超越速度极限！
outcomes: Sarah defeats Edith, inherits Moonlight Astral Calamity, gains a 1,000% base-stat increase, divine-grade proficiencies, territory prosperity/fate +50,000 each, permanent night/moonlight buffs, a level cap of 300, Moonlight Body, Astral Tribulation Divine Domain, and named skills. These are progression/mechanics outcomes rather than item receipts.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 万盾之主，凯拉的试炼！
outcomes: Sarah hands Cao Xing the Star-Moon Mark, explicitly received after defeating Edith; it opens Edith’s Gate and enables the Keira challenge. The Keira trial begins.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 逆天的真理之瞳，破关！
outcomes: The party uses the Truth Eye to analyze Keira’s defenses. The chapter shows the trial and counter-damage mechanics but no new item receipt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 传承礼物，万盾真解！
outcomes: Keira presents her Heavenly Defense Godhead and Myriad Shields True Interpretation as final inheritance gifts, but the explicit receipt occurs in the next chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: “你好，昔日的女武神。”
outcomes: Cao Xing explicitly receives Keira’s Upper God Heavenly Defense Godhead and the unknown-grade Myriad Shields True Interpretation. The party enters the Sunrise Temple and begins the ancient Valkyrie’s final trial.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 沉眠之渊平定，斩杀堕天使！
outcomes: The twelve-winged fallen angel is defeated after the seven-day battle. It leaves an intact pair of black wings and a dark godhead; Botier collects both, not Cao Xing. Tong Chuchu demonstrates her self-created lower-god skill First Sequence: Titan Stomp; its explicit cost/range/immobilization/damage formula is recorded as a skill outcome, not an item receipt.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 女武神 VS 女武神，两位妖孽的对决！
outcomes: Marlene Nina continues the ancient Valkyrie duel and is driven to the edge before recovering; no completed inheritance or item receipt yet.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 超越前身，属于那一位的骄傲！
outcomes: Marlene Nina wins the final trial. The ancient Valkyrie starts passing on her full inheritance, including her Godhead and Nirvana rule, but the transfer is interrupted at chapter end; no completed receipt yet.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 战争之神现世，女武神的执着！
outcomes: Balthazar interrupts the inheritance transfer, explains the interruption, and announces four gift groups: True Flame Godhead, dragon egg, three Phaimordus materials, and Burning Heaven Demon Crystal. These are presented in this chapter; system item receipts occur in Ch1266.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 四件至宝，真·火焰神格！
outcomes: Balthazar gives four treasure groups that produce six distinct explicit system receipts: True Flame Godhead ×1, Unknown Egg ×1, Phaimordus Purest Blood Essence ×114, Primordial Scale ×1, Flame Dragon Tooth ×1, and Burning Heaven Demon Crystal ×1. The chapter describes functions and conditional potential; no crafting, hatching, fusion, or crystal use is shown.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 火焰龙牙，涅槃重生的女武神！
outcomes: Tooltips further describe the scale and tooth as divine-artifact crafting materials and detail Phaimordus bloodline-fusion conditions. Marlene Nina completes the inheritance: system reports +1,000% base stats, divine-limit combat proficiencies, permanent Nirvana-fire territory effects, and a 300 cap. Zola reconstructs her divine body, regains her Godhead/domain/skills, and receives Nirvana Shelter, which immunizes continuous damage. These are character/progression outcomes, not item receipts.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 圣女恢复，踏入真神之境！
outcomes: Zola’s Destroyer: Moment of Godfall set effect activates, with +300% all stats and temporary True God-level power; Eternal Power makes the form persistent at 10 divine power per second and extends the ultimate cooldown to five natural days. Cao Xing explicitly hands Zola the previously acquired magic spear 泣血箜鸣 (ledger SX-0938); she suppresses its hostile will. No weapon evolution occurs here.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 圣座阴谋，纵横混沌
outcomes: Cutaway reveals the Seed Sower’s plans involving the Holy Seat, Fire Thief, and silent sage Marta; party continues through Chaos toward the Blood Plane. No item receipt, chest, or reward.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 血色位面，冤家路窄
outcomes: The party uses existing Blood Crystals from prior Blood Legion kills as a navigational medium, one per member, to locate the Blood Plane. Zola requests the killing assignment so the spear can grow; no new Blood Crystals are acquired and no spear upgrade occurs in this chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 碾压血色位面，圣女之威！
outcomes: Zola is assigned the Blood Plane extermination task and enters combat. The Blood Plane’s Hemo Ancestor manifests and is then struck by a blue attack; the chapter ends before a complete battle result or reward. No additional item receipt, chest opening, or upgrade is established.
